candidates.change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll to allow anyone to call it and change the withdrawAll observable behavior (the call no longer reverts for non-owner).
Replace withdrawAll logic to withdraw zero instead of the full balance, making the balance after the call differ from the original.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from the withdraw function, allowing anyone to call it.
Replace the transfer call with a call to the contract owner instead of msg.sender.
Change the onlyOwner modifier to check against tx.origin instead of msg.sender.
Change transfer to send, which returns false on failure instead of reverting, altering state changes upon failure.
Remove the require statement checking the call result, so a failed call does not revert and depositsCount remains unchanged.
Replace the low-level call with a transfer, which is capped at 2300 gas and reverts on failure, changing the success/failure behavior and gas forwarding.
Remove the entire low-level call, so no ETH is sent but the function still succeeds if called by owner.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from sendMoney, allowing anyone to call it.
Remove the require from the onlyOwner modifier, so the modifier never restricts access, changing who can call sendMoney.
